ClipFoundry office artwork

skyline.png is an original image generated with OpenAI image generation on
2026-10-09 for the owner's refined retro pixel office request. It depicts a
fictional dusk city in navy, purple, amber and mint. No external artist pack,
stock photograph or branded game artwork was used. The original 2172 x 724
PNG is included unchanged; the renderer selects window views at runtime.

The image is an optional local decorative asset. Missing image data keeps
procedural windows and does not prevent access to the office or its controls.
It is loaded locally without an account, network design service or paid
runtime API. See third-party-graphics.txt for graphics library notices.
